Title: Search - Sorting Results — Sort Dropdown Built from API sortings
Preconditions: Search returns multiple products with varying prices; storefront is on vc-frontend theme 2.52+ (sortings field in SearchProducts response)
Steps:
[NAV] Navigate to {{FRONT_URL}} and execute a search returning multiple products
[WAIT] Wait for results page with sort dropdown visible
[ASSERT] Snapshot the sort dropdown and capture all visible option labels and codes (live-discover: read from rendered dropdown DOM, do not assume any fixed label list)
[ASSERT] Verify the dropdown contains an option whose code is 'price-ascending' (or equivalent low-to-high label per current store config)
[ACT] Click the combobox to open the sort dropdown (VcSelect: click the combobox to open, then click the option by accessible name — do NOT use native select-option)
[ASSERT] Capture the ID of the first product card before changing sort → {first_id_before}
[ACT] Click the price-ascending option by its live-discovered label
[WAIT] Wait for results to reorder; verify ?sort=price-ascending appears in URL
[ASSERT] Verify combobox accessible name = price-ascending option label (selection reflected in control)
[ASSERT] Capture first product card ID → {first_id_asc}
[ACT] Click the combobox to open the sort dropdown again
[ACT] Click the price-descending option by its live-discovered label
[WAIT] Wait for results to reorder; verify ?sort=price-descending appears in URL
[ASSERT] Verify combobox accessible name = price-descending option label
[ASSERT] Capture first product card ID → {first_id_desc}
[ASSERT] Verify {first_id_asc} != {first_id_desc} (ascending and descending produce different first items — sort direction has observable effect)
[ACT] Click the combobox and select the default sort option (isDefault=true, identified from snapshot above)
[WAIT] Wait for results to reorder
[ASSERT] Verify URL has no ?sort param (clean URL) after selecting the default option
Assertions:
[DOM] Sort dropdown combobox visible on search results page
[DOM] Dropdown options are built from API sortings (at least 2 options present; no hardcoded sort labels assumed — options and default are store-configurable)
[STATE] Combobox accessible name reflects the selected option after each selection
[STATE] {first_id_asc} != {first_id_desc} — price-ascending and price-descending produce different first items (server-authoritative sort-direction oracle; do NOT assert monotonic price order — indexed price diverges from pack/variation-resolved price.actual)
[STATE] Selecting the store-default option (isDefault=true) results in a clean URL with no ?sort param
[NAV] URL contains ?sort=<code> for non-default selections; URL has no ?sort for the default selection
Cross_Layer_Checks:
[NETWORK] no 4xx/5xx on sort change
[NETWORK] POST /graphql (SearchProducts) includes sort parameter matching selected code
[CONSOLE] no TypeError or JS errors
Failure_Signals: Sort dropdown combobox accessible name not updating on selection; native select-option action failing (VcSelect is not a native select); {first_id_asc} == {first_id_desc} (sort direction not applied); URL not updating with sort code; default sort leaving ?sort in URL; console TypeError
References: VCST-5177; regression-qa-theme-26.csv; Corrected: VcSelect combobox + no-monotonic-price oracle (2026-06-26)

Title: Search Results - Sort Options Change Product Order (API-driven sortings)
Preconditions: Navigate to /search?q=hoodie; multiple results with varying prices; storefront uses vc-frontend theme 2.52+ which builds sort dropdown from API sortings
Steps:
[NAV] Navigate to {{FRONT_URL}}/search?q=hoodie
[WAIT] Wait for results and sort dropdown to render
[ASSERT] Snapshot the sort dropdown and capture all visible option labels (live-discover from DOM — do NOT assume any fixed label or that 'Featured' is the default)
[ASSERT] Identify the currently-selected default option — it must correspond to the sortings entry with isDefault=true returned by the API (do NOT assume a specific label; read it live from the dropdown); note its label as {default_label}
[ASSERT] Verify the URL has no ?sort param in the initial (default) state
[ASSERT] Capture first product card ID before sorting → {first_id_default}
[ACT] Click the combobox to open the sort dropdown (VcSelect: click combobox to open, then click option by accessible name — do NOT use native select-option)
[ACT] Click the price-ascending option by its live-discovered label
[WAIT] Wait for reorder
[ASSERT] Verify URL contains ?sort=price-ascending
[ASSERT] Verify combobox accessible name = price-ascending option label
[ASSERT] Capture first product card ID → {first_id_asc}
[ACT] Click the combobox and click the price-descending option by its live-discovered label
[WAIT] Wait for reorder
[ASSERT] Verify URL contains ?sort=price-descending
[ASSERT] Verify combobox accessible name = price-descending option label
[ASSERT] Capture first product card ID → {first_id_desc}
[ASSERT] Verify {first_id_asc} != {first_id_desc} (ascending and descending produce different first items — server-authoritative direction oracle)
[ACT] Click the combobox and click the name-ascending option (A-Z alphabetical) by its live-discovered label
[WAIT] Wait for reorder
[ASSERT] Verify products appear in A-Z order by name (name sort is deterministic — assert names[0] <= names[1])
[ACT] Click the combobox and select the default option (identified as {default_label} above) to return to the initial state
[WAIT] Wait for reorder
[ASSERT] Verify URL has no ?sort param after selecting default
Assertions:
[DOM] Sort dropdown combobox visible and populated with options from API sortings (at least 6 options per current store configuration)
[STATE] Initial sort is the API-configured store default (isDefault=true option); URL has no ?sort param
[STATE] Combobox accessible name reflects each selected option (VcSelect — accessible name, not native select value)
[STATE] {first_id_asc} != {first_id_desc} — price sort direction has observable effect (server-authoritative oracle; do NOT assert monotonic price order — indexed price diverges from pack/variation-resolved price.actual)
[STATE] name-ascending sort: first product name <= next product name (A-Z; name sort is deterministic)
[MATH] Product count unchanged after each sort change
[STATE] URL updates to ?sort=<code> for each non-default selection
[STATE] URL returns to clean (no ?sort) when default option selected
[DOM] Drop-down renders blank during initial load before first API response (expected behavior per VCST-5177 design)
Cross_Layer_Checks:
[NETWORK] no 4xx/5xx on sort change
[NETWORK] POST /graphql (SearchProducts) response includes sortings[] with isDefault and selected flags
[CONSOLE] no TypeError or JS errors
Failure_Signals: Sort combobox accessible name not updating on selection; native select-option failing (VcSelect is not a native select); product order unchanged after sort selection; {first_id_asc} == {first_id_desc} (sort direction not applied); URL not updating with sort code; URL not clearing on default selection; console TypeError; dropdown rendering blank permanently (not just during load)
References: VCST-5177; SRCH-007; Synced: VCST-5177 (2026-06-26); Corrected: VcSelect combobox + no-monotonic-price oracle (2026-06-26) | Behavior:srch.results.sort | DataProfile:profile.srch.results-sort
